sections.title: Verified buyer evidence
sections.sql: select f.code,f.theme,f.direction,f.excerpt,f.evidence_ref,f.reviewer from findings f join v_eligible_interviews i on i.id=f.interview_id where i.deal_id=$1 order by f.code
sections.note: Internal research only. Restricted interviews are excluded. Empty evidence means there is no eligible recorded finding.

sections.title: Evidence availability
sections.sql: select v.* from v_actions v join actions a on a.code=v.code where a.id=$1
sections.note: If evidence is restricted, review the basis before using or sharing this action.
